reason: The support needs a stable footing, so preparing the ground with the excavator seems like a useful first step.
expectation: I expect the excavator to level or otherwise prepare the ground for the replacement support.

alternatives.reason: The steel and blocks could form part of the support, but I prefer preparing the site first.

effect: The ground is ready for the footing, so I can move on to building the support.
reaction: Clearing around the loaded cribbing feels like a sensible precaution.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the steel and blocks appear useful for the replacement support.
expectation: I expect the steel and ceramic blocks to form a footing or support assembly, though its exact form is uncertain.

effect: The footing and braced frame are ready to place on the prepared ground.
reaction: The load-spreading plates make the assembly's purpose clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should put the footing on stable ground.
expectation: I expect the footing to be installed on the prepared ground, ready to support the lander.

effect: The replacement leg is assembled and ready to fasten to the lander's sound joints.
reaction: The progression from prepared ground to a braced support is clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should attach the new support to the tilted lander.
expectation: I expect the leg to be fastened to the lander and help restore a level platform, though the exact procedure is unclear.

effect: The replacement support is installed and the launch platform is level; the leg will remain behind when the upper cabin departs.
reaction: The straight ladder is a satisfying visual payoff for the repair, and unloading the damaged support before replacement makes the procedure feel sensible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the replacement leg was the most worthwhile action: it resolved the tilted platform and gave a clear visual payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the footing on the prepared ground was clear but predictable, especially as the only offered combination.

surprise.text: I hadn't anticipated that the replacement leg would stay on Mars when the upper cabin lifted away.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the ground preparation, load-spreading footing and attachment formed a clear sequence.

continue.text: I would continue to see the departure and what happens to the preserved discovery, though this chapter's choices were mostly straightforward.
